classification: Additive Robinhood Stock Token issuer context, append-only coverage policy v2 and Switchboard retirement; no partner activation
receiptImpact: Adds separate read-only Robinhood issuer context over REST and Robinhood Chain with explicit non-independent, non-quorum and non-authorizing provenance. Adds strict-300s.v2 and production-v2 append-only coverage artifacts after retiring Switchboard, while preserving v1 policy and trust bytes. Existing signed layouts, registry release, partner policies, activation mappings and historical receipts are unchanged.
activationRule: No partner activation changes. Robinhood issuer context is optional first-party instrument evidence and cannot authorize execution or satisfy independent oracle quorum. Existing consumers remain pinned to their current partner policies; coverage v2 and the issuer-context endpoint require explicit consumer adoption.

compatibilityMatrix.evidence: Existing policy, activation, signed layout and fixture remain unchanged. Robinhood issuer context and coverage v2 are additive opt-in surfaces and are not invoked automatically. No partner sign-off or new production data coverage is claimed.
